stem:
Ravi holds a bar magnet above an iron nail lying on his study table.
Before the magnet touches the nail, the nail jumps up and sticks to the magnet.
Which statement correctly explains why the nail moves?

options.text: The magnet pushes the nail away because of magnetic force.
Magnetic force acts on the iron nail without any contact between the magnet and the nail.
The nail moves because of gravitational force between the magnet and the nail.
The magnet can only exert a force on the nail after touching it.

teacher.key_rationale: The iron nail is a magnetic material and the magnet attracts it from a distance. Magnetic force is a non-contact force acting on magnets and magnetic materials, so B is correct. A is wrong because the nail is attracted, not repelled; C wrongly invokes gravity as the cause of the jump; D contradicts the non-contact nature of magnetic force.
